probe_jass:
globals
 timer cpTimer=null
 integer cpTick=0
 integer cpScene=0
 unit array cpHippo
 unit array cpArcher
 unit cpBuff=null
 item cpPotion=null
 boolean cpNested=false
endglobals
function CpBool takes boolean b returns integer
 if b then
 return 1
 endif
 return 0
endfunction
function CpMark takes string label returns nothing
 call Preload("CPF tick="+I2S(cpTick)+" scene="+I2S(cpScene)+" label="+label+" h0="+I2S(GetUnitCurrentOrder(cpHippo[0]))+" h1="+I2S(GetUnitCurrentOrder(cpHippo[1]))+" a1="+I2S(GetUnitCurrentOrder(cpArcher[1])))
 call Preload("CPF tick="+I2S(cpTick)+" scene="+I2S(cpScene)+" label=state mana="+R2S(GetUnitState(cpHippo[1],UNIT_STATE_MANA))+" max="+R2S(GetUnitState(cpHippo[1],UNIT_STATE_MAX_MANA))+" charges="+I2S(GetItemCharges(cpPotion)))
endfunction
function CpEvent takes nothing returns nothing
 local integer oid=GetIssuedOrderId()
 local boolean accepted=false
 if GetTriggerUnit()==cpHippo[0] or GetTriggerUnit()==cpHippo[1] or GetTriggerUnit()==cpArcher[0] or GetTriggerUnit()==cpArcher[1] then
 call Preload("CPF tick="+I2S(cpTick)+" scene="+I2S(cpScene)+" label=issued oid="+I2S(oid)+" actor="+I2S(GetUnitUserData(GetTriggerUnit()))+" target="+I2S(GetUnitUserData(GetOrderTargetUnit())))
 endif
 if GetTriggerUnit()==cpHippo[1] and oid>=852008 and oid<=852013 and not cpNested then
  set cpNested=true
  call CpMark("nested-before")
  set accepted=IssueTargetOrder(cpHippo[1],"coupletarget",cpArcher[1])
  call Preload("CPF tick="+I2S(cpTick)+" scene="+I2S(cpScene)+" label=nested-return accepted="+I2S(CpBool(accepted)))
  call CpMark("nested-after")
 endif
endfunction
function CpSpell takes nothing returns nothing
 call Preload("CPF tick="+I2S(cpTick)+" scene="+I2S(cpScene)+" label=spell event="+I2S(GetHandleId(GetTriggerEventId()))+" actor="+I2S(GetUnitUserData(GetTriggerUnit()))+" ability="+I2S(GetSpellAbilityId()))
endfunction
function CpTick takes nothing returns nothing
 local boolean accepted=false
 set cpTick=cpTick+1
 if cpTick==1 then
  call StartCampaignAI(Player(1),"Scripts\\target243.ai")
  call CpMark("ai-started")
 elseif cpTick==100 then
  call CpMark("ordinary-before")
  set accepted=IssueTargetOrder(cpHippo[0],"coupletarget",cpArcher[0])
  call Preload("CPF tick=100 scene=0 label=ordinary-return accepted="+I2S(CpBool(accepted)))
 elseif cpTick==500 then
  set cpScene=1
  call CpMark("outer-before")
  set accepted=IssueTargetOrder(cpHippo[1],"innerfire",cpBuff)
  call Preload("CPF tick=500 scene=1 label=outer-return accepted="+I2S(CpBool(accepted)))
  call CpMark("outer-after")
 elseif cpTick==800 then
  call CpMark("complete")
  call PreloadGenEnd("target-coupling-public243-setup-v4.txt")
  call PauseTimer(cpTimer)
 else
  if ModuloInteger(cpTick,25)==0 then
   call CpMark("sample")
  endif
 endif
endfunction
function PathProbeInit takes nothing returns nothing
 local integer i=0
 local trigger ti=CreateTrigger()
 local trigger tt=CreateTrigger()
 local trigger tp=CreateTrigger()
 local trigger ts=CreateTrigger()
 call PreloadGenClear()
 call PreloadGenStart()
 loop
  exitwhen i==2
  set cpArcher[i]=CreateUnit(Player(1),'earc',1280.0,512.0+I2R(i)*512.0,0.0)
  set cpHippo[i]=CreateUnit(Player(1),'ehip',1536.0,512.0+I2R(i)*512.0,0.0)
  call SetUnitUserData(cpArcher[i],i*2+1)
  call SetUnitUserData(cpHippo[i],i*2+2)
  call SetUnitAcquireRange(cpArcher[i],0.0)
  call SetUnitAcquireRange(cpHippo[i],0.0)
  set i=i+1
 endloop
 set cpBuff=CreateUnit(Player(1),'hfoo',1700.0,1024.0,0.0)
 call SetUnitAcquireRange(cpBuff,0.0)
 call UnitAddAbility(cpHippo[1],'AInv')
 call UnitAddAbility(cpHippo[1],'Xinf')
 call SetUnitState(cpHippo[1],UNIT_STATE_MANA,0.0)
 set cpPotion=UnitAddItemById(cpHippo[1],'pman')
 call SetPlayerTechResearched(Player(1),'Reht',1)
 call SetPlayerTechResearched(Player(1),'Rhpt',2)
 call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(ti,Player(1),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ISSUED_ORDER,null)
 call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(tt,Player(1),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ISSUED_TARGET_ORDER,null)
 call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(tp,Player(1),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ISSUED_POINT_ORDER,null)
 call TriggerAddAction(ti,function CpEvent)
 call TriggerAddAction(tt,function CpEvent)
 call TriggerAddAction(tp,function CpEvent)
 call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(ts,Player(1),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_CHANNEL,null)
 call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(ts,Player(1),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_CAST,null)
 call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(ts,Player(1),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_EFFECT,null)
 call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(ts,Player(1),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_ENDCAST,null)
 call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(ts,Player(1),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_FINISH,null)
 call TriggerAddAction(ts,function CpSpell)
 call FogEnable(false)
 call FogMaskEnable(false)
 call CpMark("start")
 call Preload("CPF tick=0 scene=0 label=setup inv="+I2S(GetUnitAbilityLevel(cpHippo[1],'AInv'))+" outer="+I2S(GetUnitAbilityLevel(cpHippo[1],'Xinf'))+" co="+I2S(GetUnitAbilityLevel(cpHippo[1],'Aco3'))+" item="+I2S(GetItemTypeId(cpPotion)))
 call PreloadGenEnd("target-coupling-public243-setup-v4-start.txt")
 call PreloadGenClear()
 call PreloadGenStart()
 set cpTimer=CreateTimer()
 call TimerStart(cpTimer,0.02,true,function CpTick)
endfunction

function main takes nothing returns nothing
 call Preload("CPF tick=0 scene=0 label=ai-thread-enter")
 call SetCampaignAI()
 call CreateCaptains()
 call SetCaptainHome(1,1536.0,1024.0)
 loop
  call Sleep(1.0)
 endloop
endfunction
